name: Bombay Oxygen Investments Limited
about: Bombay Oxygen Investments Limited operates as a non-banking financial company in India. It invests in mutual funds and other financial instruments, as well as various listed equities. The company was formerly known as Bombay Oxygen Corporation Limited and changed its name to Bombay Oxygen Investments Limited in October 2018. Bombay Oxygen Investments Limited was incorporated in 1960 and is based in Mumbai, India.
